metadata.topic: 医院门诊与承包商安全管理（一）

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the internal medicine department for fever and cold symptoms? Which floor and building is it on?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，请问看感冒发烧的内科门诊在哪一栋楼、几楼？

dialogue.en: Internal medicine is on the 2nd floor of Building A. You can register your appointment right here first.
dialogue.zh: 内科在A栋二楼，你可以先在我这里挂号。

dialogue.en: Alright, here is my medical insurance card.
dialogue.zh: 好的，这是我的医保卡。

dialogue.en: Wait for your number on the screen. The doctor will call you when it's your turn.
dialogue.zh: 在屏幕上等候叫号就可以，轮到你时医生会喊你的名字。

parts.title: Part 2: 问诊医生：症状与诊断

dialogue.en: I've had a bad cold for three days, with a high fever, sore throat and constant coughing.
dialogue.zh: 我重感冒三天了，发高烧、喉咙疼，还一直咳嗽。

dialogue.en: Let me check your temperature, pulse and breathing first. Have you had any chronic illness before?
dialogue.zh: 我先帮你量体温、检查脉搏和呼吸。你以前有慢性病吗？

dialogue.en: No, I've always been pretty healthy.
dialogue.zh: 没有，我身体一直都挺好的。

dialogue.en: It's just a viral cold, no serious infection. I'll prescribe some fever-reducer and cough syrup for you.
dialogue.zh: 只是病毒性感冒，没有严重感染。我给你开退烧药和止咳糖浆。

parts.title: Part 3: 承包商分类与总体要求

dialogue.en: We will start a facility renovation project soon. What safety work should we arrange for contractors in advance?
dialogue.zh: 我们马上要启动厂务设施改造项目，针对承包商，我们前期要做好哪些安全工作？

dialogue.en: Contractor safety management should be included in the whole project. We classify contractors into three categories: office-based team members, facilities support services, and renovation or construction contractors.
dialogue.zh: 承包商安全管理要融入项目全程。我们将承包商分为三类：驻办公室团队服务、厂务后勤服务，以及装修、设备维保与施工工程。

dialogue.en: Are there different safety requirements for these three types?
dialogue.zh: 这三类承包商的安全要求各不相同吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. They have different requirements for pre-qualifications, trainings, signing of a contract, safety meeting, PTP, worksite inspection, annual audit and quarterly performance review.
dialogue.zh: 是的，他们在资格预审、培训、合同签署、安全会议、作业前方案/作业许可、现场检查、年度审核及季度绩效评审方面有着不同要求。

dialogue.en: What is the core task of the first stage, Pre-Qualification and Selection?
dialogue.zh: 第一阶段资格预审与筛选，核心工作是什么？

dialogue.en: We must collect a completed Contractor Prequalification Form from every bidding contractor at first.
dialogue.zh: 我们首先必须收取所有投标承包商填写完整的《承包商资格预审表》。

dialogue.en: What key contents do we need to check on this pre-qualification form?
dialogue.zh: 这份资格预审表，我们重点要核查哪些内容？

dialogue.en: We check their licences, certifications, qualifications, three-year reportable injuries, safety citations from Gov. agencies and some items of their E. H. S. management systems.
dialogue.zh: 我们核查其执照、资质证书、从业资格、近三年可记录工伤事故、政府监管机构出具的安全违规处罚通知以及一些E. H. S.管理系统方面的问题。

dialogue.en: Once we select a qualified contractor after pre-qualification, what is the next key step?
dialogue.zh: 我们通过预审选定合格承包商之后，下一步关键流程是什么？

dialogue.en: All contractor staff must finish our designated online orientation training and their specific trainings.
dialogue.zh: 所有承包商人员必须完成我们指定的线上入职安全培训，还有他们自己的专项培训。

dialogue.en: Great, training is very important. Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 很好，培训十分重要，还有其他事项吗？

dialogue.en: Sure, they need to conduct hazard identification and risk assessment in advance for the contractor activities and submit their work safety plan.
dialogue.zh: 当然，他们事先需针对承包商作业开展危险源辨识与风险评估，并提交作业安全方案。

dialogue.en: Does the second stage require them to sign a safety agreement?
dialogue.zh: 第二阶段作业前安全准备，要求签订安全协议？

dialogue.en: Absolutely, we shall sign a formal Safety Agreement with them prior to the start of work in order to comply with Work Safety Law.
dialogue.zh: 一定的，为了符合安全生产法的要求，在开工前和对方签订正式安全生产管理协议。

dialogue.en: Got it. Safety is the foundation of every project.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。安全是每一个项目的基础。
